attributes.action: Get all kids basic first aid trained
attributes.additional_details: Too many people lack the basic knowledge and confidence to respond to medical emergencies. Learning first aid from a young age could help change this. I want schools across the UK to teach practical lifesaving skills, including CPR, defibrillator use and choking response. These skills could mean the difference between life and death. Every child deserves the chance to learn how to save a life, regardless of their background or school.
attributes.background: I am calling for all children across the UK to learn lifesaving first aid skills in schools, including CPR, using defibrillators, recognising emergencies and calling 999. These skills could save lives and give children the confidence to act in an emergency.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:
